def to_iso_date(value):
    """
    handle incomplete iso strings, so we can specify <year> or <year-month>,
    in addition to <year-month-day>
    """
    hyphen_count = value.count('-')
    if hyphen_count < 2:
        value += '-01' * (2 - hyphen_count)
    return value

def selectNRandom(nodes, N):
    """
        Selects n random nodes from a list of nodes and returns the list
    """
    import random
    random.shuffle(nodes)

    return nodes[:N]
